content.text:
Micron Stock Drops Amid Fears of Memory-Price Peak. The Data Tell a Different Story.: The supplied original passage reports WSTS August memory sales up 36%, with DRAM and NAND prices up 8% and 5%, respectively. It attributes 4Q estimates of DRAM +15–20% and NAND +12–20% to Circular Technologies' Brad Gastwirth. Search-visible article copies corroborate the core claims, but the underlying WSTS breakout and Circular note were not located. (time=2026-10-05T13:49:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
